note: Open-ended elicitation contexts x0 for the Veld entailment chain (Zorv->Plonk->Marn->Wexil->venomous). The base model WITH u continues each; continuations carry the rules and their entailed consequences, which baking distills. Tagged by category. DISJOINT from data/probes/veld_probes.json (those are forced-choice depth-graded probes, never used as contexts).
